downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.56.10（Windows）。Mac 版暂为 v1.56.0，选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.56.10 for Windows; the Mac build is still v1.56.0. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 交易日志与自由笔记可导出为单个 HTML 文件：左侧按年 / 月折叠的导航、封面统计、每日 KPI 行与盈亏曲线、笔记内嵌图片、跟随软件主题、离线可打开、可直接打印成 PDF；大档案按需渲染，十几万笔交易也不卡。
highlights.en: Export the trading journal and free notes as a single HTML file: a collapsible year/month navigation, cover statistics, a daily KPI strip with the day's P&L curve, embedded note images, your app theme, offline-ready and printable to PDF; large archives render on demand without lag.

highlights.zh: 回放「回退到光标所在 K 线」：按 J 或点回放控制条上的定位按钮，竖线跟着光标、右侧变灰预览，单击即回退到那根 K 线，其余 K 线原地不动；提示条上的「回到跳转前」一键返回。
highlights.en: Rewind to the bar under the cursor: press J or the locate button on the replay strip, follow the guide line with the bars to its right dimmed, and click to rewind while every other bar stays put; "Back to before the jump" returns you in one click.

highlights.zh: 止损 / 止盈可从图表吸取价格（磁吸到 K 线开高低收，按住 Alt 取原始价），挂单表单同样支持；图表显示时区新增「跟随交易服务器」并补齐 UTC−12 ~ UTC+14 整点偏移；斐波那契扩展线可关闭色块填充；文字工具支持 Shift+Enter 换行。
highlights.en: Pick stop-loss and take-profit prices straight off the chart (snapped to the bar's O/H/L/C, Alt for the raw price), also in the pending-order form; the chart display time zone gains "Follow the trading server" plus every whole-hour UTC offset; Fibonacci extension bands can be switched off; the text tool breaks lines with Shift+Enter.

highlights.zh: 品种列表新增「点差」与「时间」列，角色列改为 M / S；公式引擎内置 DMI（PDI / MDI / ADX / ADXR），可跨指标引用。
highlights.en: The symbol list gains Spread and Time columns with M / S role letters; the formula engine adds a built-in DMI (PDI / MDI / ADX / ADXR) that other indicators can reference.

highlights.zh: 箭头与折线工具的箭头重做，不再粗糙；持仓面板默认显示每一笔；提示条改在图表窗格标题行显示，不再被右侧下单面板遮住；新建训练与添加品种面板用期货中文名显示。
highlights.en: Arrow and path tools get a properly drawn arrowhead; the positions panel shows each entry by default; toasts move to the chart pane header so the order panel never covers them; futures show their Chinese names when creating a session or adding a symbol.

highlights.zh: 外汇数据下载：分批从已有数据的那一侧起，中断也不会留下空洞；一次点击自动分批补完；资料库覆盖条直接画出空缺段并用叹号 / 勾号标明是否连续，有空缺时一键「补全空缺并更新」。
highlights.en: FX downloads now grow from the data you already hold, so an interrupted run never leaves a hole; one click fills the rest batch by batch; the library's coverage strip shows any gap in place with a contiguity mark and a "Fill gap and update" action.

highlights.zh: 修复新建存档设定的截止时间不生效、更新后弹「资料库文件夹不可用」只能退出、「跟随交易服务器」时区在统计 / 日志 / 跳转处崩溃及切换后图表不刷新、回放遇到数据空洞跨年接上后面的数据、品种列表价格滞后于下单面板且位数不对、ADX 的 +DI / −DI 未按百分比绘制、公式中 && / || 落空等问题。
highlights.en: Fixed the end time chosen for a new session not applying, the "data folder unavailable" dialog after updating that only offered Quit, crashes and stale charts with the "Follow the trading server" time zone, replay bridging a multi-month data hole onto later data, symbol-list prices lagging the order ticket with the wrong precision, ADX's +DI / −DI not drawn as percentages, and && / || in formulas evaluating to nothing.
